name: Naive and memory B cell surface signatures
rationale: All members are B cell or lymphocyte expression/surface signatures and memory responses, distinguished from confusables by resting naive/memory B cell markers rather than germinal centre, Tfh or plasma cell differentiation.

qualifier: melanin synthesis and pigment granule localization
name: MITF-M melanocyte program and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members are MITF-M target-gene programs plus melanin biosynthesis, pigment granule transport and pigment-related metabolite regulation, unlike confusables centred on UV/blue light responses and melanocyte proliferation.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, cadherin turnover in EMT
name: Epithelial cadherin junctions, desmosomes and polarity in EMT
rationale: Members cover adherens, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, apical-basal polarity and EMT, distinguishing them from endothelial adherens regulation and tight-junction barrier confusables.

name: Pyrimidine-predominant nucleotide catabolism and salvage
rationale: Members are catabolism and salvage of pyrimidine (deoxy)nucleotides, nucleosides and bases (plus dGMP), unlike confusables on purine deoxynucleotides, de novo pyrimidine synthesis or NUDT triphosphate hydrolysis.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate and alkanesulfonate transport
rationale: Members are SLC4 bicarbonate transporters and their diseases plus alkanesulfonate transport/metabolism, separating them from SLC26 anion exchange, carbonic anhydrase and enamel confusables.

qualifier: homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation of stem/progenitors
name: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell maintenance and differentiation
rationale: All members concern HSC homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation in post-embryonic hemopoiesis, unlike confusables focused on erythroid or thymic T cell development.

qualifier: cell-type-specific BAF assembly and stem cell maintenance
name: BAF chromatin remodeler variants and stem cell maintenance
rationale: Members are assembly of cBAF, ncBAF, pBAF, esBAF and neuronal BAF variants plus CHD1/2 remodelers and stem cell maintenance, unlike confusables on histone acetylation and nucleosome assembly.

qualifier: cellular uptake, intracellular processing and cofactor-enzyme defects
name: Cellular cobalamin uptake, processing and cofactor-enzyme defects
rationale: Members are TCN2/CD320 transport, intracellular cobalamin processing and MUT/MTR/propionyl-CoA defects, distinct from confusables on dietary intestinal cobalamin uptake and other B vitamins.

qualifier: oncogene, stress and replicative induction with heterochromatin foci and SASP
name: Oncogene, stress and replicative senescence with heterochromatin foci
rationale: Members cover oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence, SAHF, PML bodies, Polycomb silencing and SASP, unlike confusables on UV response, p53 apoptosis or cancer evasion of senescence.

core: TAK1 complex activation in toll-like receptor signaling
name: TRAF6-mediated TAK1 activation downstream of toll-like receptors
rationale: Members describe TRAF6-, IRAK2- and TRIF-dependent TAK1/IKK activation within TLR signaling, distinct from TRIF-mediated cell death, IRAK1-IKK recruitment and JNK confusables.

qualifier: droplet formation and fusion with triglyceride homeostasis
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and intracellular triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members are lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization plus triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike confusables on lipophagy, lipolysis or phospholipid synthesis.

name: Keratinocyte cornification and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members are cornified envelope assembly, peptide cross-linking, keratinocyte development and skin barrier establishment, distinct from keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation control, junction and lipoxygenase confusables.

name: Constitutive signaling by oncogenic EGFR and ERBB2 mutants
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated EGFR and ERBB2 mutants, unlike confusables on drug resistance of ERBB2 mutants or FGFR fusions/amplifications.

name: Cytidine deaminase editing in antiviral restriction and antibody diversification
rationale: Members link APOBEC/AID cytidine deamination to HIV restriction and to somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J and B cell development, unlike confusables on adenosine-to-inosine editing or HIV life cycle.

name: Histamine, prostanoid and leukotriene G protein-coupled receptor signaling
rationale: Members are GPCRs and responses for histamine, prostanoids and leukotrienes, distinguished from confusables on eicosanoid synthesis and endocannabinoids by the histamine receptor arm.

qualifier: mucosal, via lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration
name: Mucosal antibacterial defense via lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration
rationale: Members cover mucosal and neutrophil killing of bacteria, cytolysis, agglutination, peptidoglycan handling and metal sequestration, unlike defensin, antifungal and nematode confusables.

name: Cobalamin, folate and methionine one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members span cobalamin uptake and processing, folate interconversion and transport, and methionine/SAM metabolism, unlike confusables on thiamine, riboflavin, carnitine or choline.

qualifier: CYP-mediated vitamin D and retinoic acid activation and catabolism
name: Vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism and signaling
rationale: Members are CYP27B1/CYP24A1 vitamin D and CYP26 retinoic acid metabolism with their responses, unlike steroidogenesis, vitamin K and retinol/retinal confusables.

core: ER protein targeting and quality control
qualifier: SRP and tail-anchored insertion, retention and exit
name: SRP and tail-anchored ER targeting, retention and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and post-translational ER targeting, membrane insertion, ER retention, exit and quality control, unlike confusables on ERAD or COPII transport.

name: Androgen receptor signaling and RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation
rationale: Members combine androgen/testosterone responses and AR regulation with RUNX2 control of osteoblast and bone development, distinct from estrogen and other nuclear receptor confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase and beta-arrestin
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor signaling through adenylate cyclase and beta-arrestin and its locomotor output, unlike confusables on dopamine synthesis, transport, addiction or PLC coupling.

name: Heme and heme A biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern heme biosynthesis and metabolism including heme A, unlike confusables on iron-sulfur clusters, HMOX1/iron responses or heme B/protoporphyrinogen.

name: RNA pseudouridylation and mitochondrial tRNA processing
rationale: Members are pseudouridine synthesis in mRNA, tRNA and rRNA and mitochondrial tRNA processing/3'-end modification, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation, methylation or mitoribosome assembly.

name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and syncytium formation
rationale: Members are receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and induced cell-cell fusion, distinct from virus-specific entry, assembly and protein maturation confusables.

core: Small RNA biogenesis and gene silencing
qualifier: miRNA and siRNA processing and RISC
name: MicroRNA and siRNA biogenesis and gene silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing, RISC assembly, miRNA turnover and miRNA-mediated translational repression and decay, unlike confusables on RBP-driven mRNA decay, decapping or ceRNAs.
